integrity_notes: The two-center special case is already implied by the primary source trace identity; the stated extension is to arbitrary finite \(k\).
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the normalized planar system with potential one-half norm-squared plus a finite sum of positive inverse-distance point-mass terms.
The conclusion concerns the strict KCC Jacobi-stability criterion only and does not imply ordinary linear or orbital instability.
Singular centers are excluded; arbitrary fixed centers need not form a physically self-consistent relative equilibrium.
title: A positive-trace obstruction to Jacobi stability in planar point-mass fields
